description:
Approved by the user 2026-11-17 (relayed by the Optimize session: "proceed").

lib/enum.fz:156 builds a range's list as reverse(reverse(e)), so every cell is built twice. A one-pass range clause takes GC's g_enum list memory from 35.84 MB to 25.6 MB (BEAM ~18 MB); 48 call sites gain.

Overlap: fz-engine's R2 library-rewrite option touches lib/range.fz; if R2 gives a one-pass builder this clause is deleted. fz-nhb.12 (lib/*.fz spec rewrite, Fixture Rework) touches lib/*.fz too: the second to land rebases.
title: Enum.to_list builds a range's list once
